lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots are arranged in semi-regular vertical columns posterior to the gills. The spots form a repetitive grid-like pattern with roughly equidistant spacing between local maxima across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot alignments. Spots are predominantly centered within these vertical bands, creating a visible nodal grid structure on the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible. The most prominent dorsal ridge displays a sharp transition from high-luminance pixels on the superior edge to low-luminance shadow on the inferior edge, following a linear path parallel to the longitudinal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark, fusiform silhouette with high-contrast boundaries relative to the water column is visible below the ventral-posterior region of the shark, indicating the presence of a commensal organism.
